_note: The canonical sound vocabulary. Each entry says what the sound is FOR, so placement is a semantic decision rather than a guess. Volumes are peak targets in dBFS; see rules/sound.md for how they relate to the voice.
_license: Fetched from Mixkit, whose free licence permits use in commercial video without attribution. Licence is recorded per file at fetch time. Never add audio whose licence you have not checked — an unlicensed effect in a monetised video is the user's problem, not yours.

visual.title: Visual enhancements and graphic elements
visual.use: Give weight to a digital object arriving on screen.

pop.when: A single emoji, sticker, icon or small element appears.

whoosh_light.when: Fast text slide-in, a lower third, a shape animation.

keyboard.when: Text reveals letter-by-letter or word-by-word; a terminal types.

click.when: A list row lands, an item is ticked, something is selected or circled.

shutter.when: A screenshot, photo or mock-up freezes on screen.

ding.when: A winning point, a tip, a key metric, a positive result.

transition.title: Scene transitions and camera movement
transition.use: Mask a cut, change topic, or match a camera move.

whoosh_deep.when: Whip pan, crash zoom, or moving from talking head to B-roll.

swoosh.when: A light slide between images. Softer than a deep whoosh.

glitch.when: Cutting to a screen, a retro filter, a flashback, an error.

rewind.when: Stop the momentum: a mistake, a hard topic change.

pacing.title: Psychological and pacing triggers
pacing.use: Command attention or shift the viewer's state. Use sparingly.

impact.when: The hook lands, or a major realisation is stated.

riser.when: Building into a reveal or a punchline.

record_scratch.when: A sudden twist or interruption. At most once, ever.

heartbeat.when: Tension immediately before a reveal or a result.

clock.when: Urgency: a deadline, a limited offer, a countdown.

notification.when: The single biggest number or reveal in the piece. Once only.

texture.title: Ambient and textural beds
texture.use: Sit well under the voice for the whole time they play. These are beds, never punctuation.

paper.when: Deleting an idea, starting over, a document or scrapbook look.

crowd.when: Talking about being in public, an event, a business.

hiss.when: Vintage or cosy grade over raw B-roll.
